actionable_steps.citation: Let God Be Your Guru — SSS Vol 16 (1983), 1983-07-24
actionable_steps.step: Look upon God alone as your true Guru — on this holy day of Guru Puurnima, resolve to purify your mind and install Him in your heart.

actionable_steps.citation: Develop Faith And Self-confidence To Gain Selfrealisation — SSS Vol 41 (2008), 2008-07-18
actionable_steps.step: Remember that your own heart is your guru — whatever comes from the depth of your own heart is the real teaching.
Examine the guru and his credentials, ideals, and practice before accepting him — watch, study, and weigh.

actionable_steps.citation: He and He alone — SSS Vol 11 (1971 - 72)
actionable_steps.step: Have faith in the Guru — for then alone will your steps be steady and firm on the path to self-realisation; that faith must lead to faith in the Atma.
Pray to the God within you — the Maheshwara, the Vishnu, the Brahma, or Parabrahma Principle — to reveal Itself; accept that as the Guru.
Serve the Guru wholeheartedly — devoted service to the Guru evokes his Grace, as Padmapada's washing of the clothes showed.

definition.citation: All Are Embodiments of Brahman (Alternative Translation) — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-30
definition.quote: What is the inner meaning of the term guru? One who dispels the darkness of ignorance is a guru (Gukaro andhakarasya rukaro thannivaranam). Not only this, the term guru has another meaning: One who is attributeless and formless is the true Guru (Gukaro gunateeta, rukaro rupavarjita). Only Brahman is beyond attributes and forms. Therefore, Brahman is the only true Guru.

discourses.citation: Manifest the Divine within you — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-07-20
discourses.quote: Only God is the true Guru. All others are merely teachers, like the teachers of different subjects in a college. Guru is the one who reveals the guri (target) to the disciple. Guri here refers to the Athmik Principle.

discourses.citation: God Alone Is The Sadhguru — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-07-14
discourses.quote: Guru is not one who merely teaches. A Guru is omnipotent, omniscient and omnipresent, He is God himself. Guru is Brahma, Vishnu and Easwara.

discourses.citation: Experience the fullness of love — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-07-22
discourses.quote: Gu means darkness and Ru means dispelling. Guru means one who dispels darkness (the preceptor who dispels the darkness of ignorance).

discourses.citation: All Are Embodiments of Brahman (Alternative Translation) — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-30
discourses.quote: Who is your Guru? You yourself are your Guru. Your mind itself is your Guru. The moment you realise this truth, there will be no need for you to have any other Guru.

make_it_real: God is the Guru, and He sits in your own heart — listen to Him first, follow His light, and let every act be an offering to Him.
title: Guru

vahinis.quote: Respect the guru as the person who shows you the path, who looks after your progress and is interested in your welfare. Worship the Lord as the witness of everything everywhere, as the master of creation, preservation, and dissolution, and as the All-Powerful One.
The guru must wake up those who are enveloped in the sleep of ignorance and reward them with teachings on the knowledge of their Atmic Reality.
